description: This file defines the ArrayArgumentHelper class, which provides utility methods for handling and analyzing array arguments within the PHPSpreadsheet calculation engine. It manages array dimensions, detects vector types, and supports operations like flattening, filtering, and identifying matrix pairs.

classes.name: ArrayArgumentHelper
classes.description: A helper class to analyze and process array arguments in spreadsheet formulas, including identifying vectors, matrices, and managing array dimensions.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Initializes the helper with provided arguments, capturing array dimensions and flattening single-cell arrays.

methods.name: hasArrayArgument
methods.description: Checks if any of the arguments are arrays.

methods.name: getFirstArrayArgumentNumber
methods.description: Returns the index (1-based) of the first array argument.

methods.name: getSingleRowVector
methods.description: Returns the index of a single row vector argument if only one exists.

methods.name: getRowVectors
methods.description: Internal method to find all row vector arguments.

methods.name: getSingleColumnVector
methods.description: Returns the index of a single column vector argument if only one exists.

methods.name: getColumnVectors
methods.description: Internal method to find all column vector arguments.

methods.name: getMatrixPair
methods.description: Finds a pair of arguments forming a matrix, based on their array dimensions.

methods.name: isVector
methods.description: Checks if an argument is a vector (row or column).

methods.name: isRowVector
methods.description: Checks if an argument is a row vector.

methods.name: isColumnVector
methods.description: Checks if an argument is a column vector.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows for a specified argument.

methods.name: columnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns for a specified argument.

methods.name: rows
methods.description: Internal method to determine the row dimensions of each argument.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Internal method to determine the column dimensions of each argument.

methods.name: arrayArguments
methods.description: Counts how many arguments are arrays.

methods.name: flattenSingleCellArrays
methods.description: Converts single-cell array arguments into scalar values for easier processing.

methods.name: filterArray
methods.description: Utility to filter array indices based on dimension criteria.
